title: parallel reviewers race: the sentinel's test captures leak caches into the tree the enforcer scans
detail: With regression-sentinel and conventions-enforcer spawned together, the sentinel's pytest captures wrote __pycache__ and .pytest_cache into worktrees/solo while the enforcer ran its leakage check, giving a false FAIL (52 pyc files) and a full re-review. The enforcer's suggested PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE trips the hot-path perf tests in the engine repo. Reviewers need sequencing or isolated trees.
